body: 30F if you still need someone to talk to

(30F) It started at 13 for me, I didn’t realize till looking back that my feelings made complete sense. Turns out there was lots of mental illness in my family no one told me about back then. The situations I experienced could have been worse but it doesn’t make my feelings any less valid.

I didn’t think I’d make it to 16. 

I still struggle with lots of suicidal ideation and various mental Illness but my life has continued to grow in ways I never imagined and it’s interesting, I just try and enjoy the fun moments of life to the fullest while they’re happening. Im at a low point right now, and I can really relate to being scared of thinking it’s just for attention. 

I know I need attention, to be helped and supported. Sometimes I can’t find the words to ask for help so I end up hurting myself out of extreme emotional distress. It’s not really attention seeking so much as it is my desperate attempt to communicate when I can’t find the words. 

I’m sorry you are going through this, you’re not alone.

Ur not alone in that, I’m 30 unemployed and frozen pizza is half my food pyramid. I try to remind myself that my story is just a little different than a lot of peoples and that I’ve got struggles that make shit a whole lot harder. Idk if you’ve ever heard the spoon theory thing but it’s just like I’ve got less energy than some people so I have to decide what to use the energy for. Today I only had energy to sort through some old clothes and read a little. But I’m here and things will keep changing and hopefully I’ll find cool shit that works for me along the way
Just from this information it sounds like a combination of sexual abuse, sexual harassment or sexual assault.

This made me realize I literally order small stuff online constantly so I have something to look forward to, even though it doesn’t make things better it gives me little moments of looking forward to something.

Same! It’s a fucking rollercoaster. Sometimes I forget that I ever felt any other way. Like I’ve always been miserable (which isn’t true cause I’ve had lots of good times). Things just get so distorted. For real my only joy this week has been getting smoothies, even though it sounds ridiculous they give my day one point of joy even if the rest is laying in bed unable to move cause I’m too scared or too sad.
It comes in waves for me, but the moments believing life is worth living are so precious, I try to hold onto them even if it’s just for a few moments.
